title: Nostalgic Modernity
description: Modern minecraft meets some elements of Beta and mods
body:
# Modern Minecraft with nostalgia-tinted glasses

## Features
- Beta appearance
- No hunger
- NO SLEEPING; beware of the night, go spelunking or set up a base fence
- No insomnia as well: phantoms only appear at night high in the mountains
- No Sprinting: Horses get a buff and now are super viable for exploring
- Beta-inspired terrain generation
- Less structures in the overwold: No temples, no pyramids, no villages, no outposts
- No Villagers, Pillagers nor wandering trader

## Modded Content
Inspired by "classics"
- Create a factory with the whole Voltz package: Electrodynamics, nuclear sciences, assembly lines, etc
- Explore the depth of space with Stellaris
- Make trains with Railcraft
- Become a Thaumaturge with Theurgy
